SPIREOFFACTORIO-COMPLEX_RECIPE.title: Complex Recipe
SPIREOFFACTORIO-COMPLEX_RECIPE.descripti:
Gain {DexterityPower:diff()} [gold]Dexterity[/gold] this turn.
Additionally, gain {Block::diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] for each copy of this card in your hand.

SPIREOFFACTORIO-ASSEMBLED_STRIKE.descrip:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.{HasRider:{Strength:
Gain {RiderStrength:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold].|}{Heal:
Heal [green]{RiderHeal:diff()}%[/green] of your Max HP.|}{Poison:
Apply {RiderPoison:diff()} [gold]Poison[/gold].|}{Shivs:
Add {RiderShivs:diff()} [gold]{RiderShivs:plural:Shiv|Shivs}[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].|}{MinionStrike:
Choose a card in your [gold]Hand[/gold] to [gold]Transform[/gold] into [gold]{IfUpgraded:show:Minion Strike+|Minion Strike}[/gold].|}{Forge:
[gold]Forge[/gold] {RiderForge:diff()}.|}{Summon:
[gold]Summon[/gold] {RiderSummon:diff()}.|}{Doom:
Apply {RiderDoom:diff()} [gold]Doom[/gold].|}{Lightning:
[gold]Channel[/gold] {RiderLightning:diff()} [gold]Lightning[/gold].|}{Plasma:

Apply {RiderShock:diff()} [gold]Shock[/gold].|}{Scorch:

SPIREOFFACTORIO-NOT_MY_PROBLEM.title: Not My Problem
SPIREOFFACTORIO-NOT_MY_PROBLEM.descripti: [gold]Exhaust[/gold] up to {ExhaustCount} cards in your hand, gain {Scrap:scrapIcons()} equal to the {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} cost of the exhausted cards.

SPIREOFFACTORIO-REINFORCED_PLATING.descr: Increase the health of the selected [blue]construct[/blue] by {Heal:diff()}.

SPIREOFFACTORIO-HUNKER_DOWN.description: All of your [blue]constructs[/blue] gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold], but gain {Disabled} stack{Disabled:plural:|s} of [gold]Disabled[/gold].
SPIREOFFACTORIO-CONSTRUCTION_ROBOT.title: Construction Robot
SPIREOFFACTORIO-CONSTRUCTION_ROBOT.descr: At the start of your turn, repair all [blue]constructs[/blue] {ConstructionRobot} HP.

Deal {Damage:diff()} damage, and apply {VulnerablePower:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold].
Increase this card's damage by {Increase:diff()} this combat.
SPIREOFFACTORIO-COVERING_FIRE.title: Covering Fire
SPIREOFFACTORIO-COVERING_FIRE.descriptio: {CoveringFire}% of damage dealt by [blue]constructs[/blue] is gained as [gold]Block[/gold].
SPIREOFFACTORIO-GRID_REDIRECTION.title: Grid Redirection
SPIREOFFACTORIO-CARGO_DELIVERY.title: Cargo Delivery
SPIREOFFACTORIO-CARGO_DELIVERY.descripti: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Damage is increased by {CargoDeliveryWeakIncrease}% for each stack of [gold]Weak[/gold] on the target.
SPIREOFFACTORIO-HELLFIRE.title: Hellfire
SPIREOFFACTORIO-HELLFIRE.description: Apply {Scorch} [gold]Scorch[/gold] to the selected enemy. [gold]Scorch[/gold] is increased by {HellfireVulnerableIncrease}% for each stack of [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] on the target.

SPIREOFFACTORIO-OVERDRIVE.title: Overdrive
SPIREOFFACTORIO-FLASHBANG_GRENADE.title: Flashbang Grenade
SPIREOFFACTORIO-SLOW_GRENADE.title: Slow Grenade
SPIREOFFACTORIO-SLOW_GRENADE.description: The targeted enemy losses {StrengthPower:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold] and {DexterityPower:diff()} [gold]Dexterity[/gold]. Apply {Shock} [gold]Shock[/gold] to all enemies.
SPIREOFFACTORIO-DISCHARGE_DEFENSE.title: Discharge Defense
SPIREOFFACTORIO-DISCHARGE_DEFENSE.descri: Whenever an enemy attacks you, they gain {DischargeDefense} [gold]Shock[/gold].
SPIREOFFACTORIO-POWER_IMPACT.title: Power Impact
SPIREOFFACTORIO-POWER_IMPACT.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Damage is increased by {PowerImpactBlockBuff} for each [gold]Block[/gold], [gold]Plating[/gold], and [gold]Titanium[/gold] you have.
SPIREOFFACTORIO-HARDENED_STEEL.title: Hardened Steel
SPIREOFFACTORIO-HARDENED_STEEL.descripti: Your constructs gain [blue]{HardenedSteel}[/blue]% additional [gold]Block[/gold] when you play blocking cards.
SPIREOFFACTORIO-DEEPER_RESEARCH.title: Deeper Research
SPIREOFFACTORIO-DEEPER_RESEARCH.descript: Whenever a non-generated Colorless card is played, add a random {IfUpgraded:show:upgraded }Colorless card to your hand.
SPIREOFFACTORIO-IMPROVISED_DEFENSE.title: Improvised Defense
SPIREOFFACTORIO-IMPROVISED_DEFENSE.descr: Select a [blue]construct[/blue]. Any damage you would take this turn is first absorbed by the selected construct.
SPIREOFFACTORIO-PALLISADES.title: Pallisades
SPIREOFFACTORIO-PALLISADES.description: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] X times. Half of the amount of block gained is also gained next turn.
SPIREOFFACTORIO-RAIN_OF_TRASH.title: Rain of Trash
SPIREOFFACTORIO-MINING_DRILL.title: Mining Drill
SPIREOFFACTORIO-MINING_DRILL.description: At the start of your turn, gain {Scrap:scrapIcons()}{IfUpgraded:show:{Scrap:scrapIcons()}} for each open [blue]construct[/blue] slot you have.
SPIREOFFACTORIO-LIMITLESS_PRODUCTION.des: For this turn, convert the {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} cost of all cards in your hand to {Scrap:scrapIcons(1)}.
SPIREOFFACTORIO-LOGISTICS_ROBOT.title: Logistics Robot
SPIREOFFACTORIO-LOGISTICS_ROBOT.descript:
Select another player, take {SelectCount} card{SelectCount:plural:|s} from that players discard pile and add it to your hand. It is free to play this turn.{IfUpgraded:show:
Upgrade the card, then move a copy of the card you took to the top of the original player's draw pile.}
SPIREOFFACTORIO-LOGISTICS_ROBOT.selectio: Select {SelectCount} card{SelectCount:plural:|s} to add to your hand.
SPIREOFFACTORIO-TRANSMISSION.title: Transmission
SPIREOFFACTORIO-SHOCK_AND_AWE.title: Shock and Awe
SPIREOFFACTORIO-TESLA_TURRET.title: Tesla Turret
SPIREOFFACTORIO-GRID_CRASH.title: Grid Crash
SPIREOFFACTORIO-GRID_CRASH.description: Apply {Overclock} [gold]Overclock[/gold] to all allied [blue]constructs[/blue] on the field.
SPIREOFFACTORIO-ROBOTICS_ASSEMBLY_ROUTIN: Add {RobotCards} {IfUpgraded:show:upgraded }[blue]Robot[/blue] card{RobotCards:plural:|s} to your hand, they are free to play this turn.
Select {RobotCards} card{RobotCards:plural:|s} to add to your hand.
SPIREOFFACTORIO-TARGETING_ROUTINE.title: Targeting Routine
SPIREOFFACTORIO-TARGETING_ROUTINE.descri: Select a single target, this turn, your [blue]constructs[/blue] will only attack this target, dealing {TargetingRoutineExtra}% extra damage.
SPIREOFFACTORIO-RAILGUN_SHOT.title: Railgun Shot
SPIREOFFACTORIO-RAILGUN_SHOT.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} [gold]unblockable[/gold] damage. If the target has a damage reduction buff excluding [gold]Intangible[/gold], remove it and deal an additional additional {RailgunExtra} damage. Removes all [gold]Block[/gold] on the target.
SPIREOFFACTORIO-EFFICIENT_POWERING_NETWO: You lose {EfficientPoweringNetwork} stack{EfficientPoweringNetwork:plural:|s} of [gold]Overload[/gold] at the start of your turn.
SPIREOFFACTORIO-GUNSMITH.title: Gunsmith
SPIREOFFACTORIO-GUNSMITH.description: All players select a [gold]Rare Engineer[/gold] card and add it to their hand.{IfUpgraded:show: It is free to play this turn.}
SPIREOFFACTORIO-GUNSMITH.selectionScreen: Select a [gold]Rare Engineer[/gold] card to add to your hand.
SPIREOFFACTORIO-THE_NUCLEAR_OPTION.title: The Nuclear Option
SPIREOFFACTORIO-THE_NUCLEAR_OPTION.descr: Deal {Damage:diff()} [gold]unblockable[/gold] damage, apply the maximum [gold]Shock[/gold] to [gold]Stun[/gold] next turn and {Scorch} [gold]Scorch[/gold] to all enemies.
SPIREOFFACTORIO-FUSION_REACTOR.title: Fusion Reactor
SPIREOFFACTORIO-FUSION_REACTOR.descripti: Gain {FusionReactorSlots} [blue]construct[/blue] slots. [blue]Constructs[/blue] spawn with [gold]Overclock[/gold] and no longer lose [gold]Overclock[/gold] when performing actions. You no longer gain [gold]Overload[/gold] from construct actions.
SPIREOFFACTORIO-PROMPT_CRITICAL.title: Prompt Critical
SPIREOFFACTORIO-PROMPT_CRITICAL.descript: Apply {Overclock} [gold]Overclock[/gold] to the selected [blue]Construct[/blue], after the construct performs an action, it explodes, dealing {PromptCritical} damage to all enemies, then dies.
SPIREOFFACTORIO-GIFT_OF_GLEBA.title: Gift of Gleba
SPIREOFFACTORIO-GIFT_OF_GLEBA.descriptio: After {Turns} turn{Turns:plural:|s}, heal [green]{CropHarvest}[/green]. Heal amount is reduced if you take unblocked damage prior to the buff being activated.
SPIREOFFACTORIO-BLUEPRINT.title: Blueprint
SPIREOFFACTORIO-BLUEPRINT.description: The next {ReducedScrapCost} card{ReducedScrapCost:plural:|s} with {Scrap:scrapIcons()} cost will have the {Scrap:scrapIcons()} cost halved. If {Scrap:scrapIcons()} was one, the cost is removed.
SPIREOFFACTORIO-EMERGENCY_RECALL.title: Emergency Recall
SPIREOFFACTORIO-EMERGENCY_RECALL.descrip:
Deconstruct the selected [blue]construct[/blue], add its card to your hand with a free {Scrap:scrapIcons()} cost until the card has been played.{IfUpgraded:show:
The construct card is given [gold]Retain[/gold]}
SPIREOFFACTORIO-VOLTAIC_INFERNO.title: Voltaic Inferno
SPIREOFFACTORIO-VOLTAIC_INFERNO.descript: Whenever you apply [gold]Shock[/gold] to an enemy, Apply {VoltaicInferno} [gold]Scorch[/gold] to that enemy.
SPIREOFFACTORIO-FORCE_REDIRECTION.title: Force Redirection
SPIREOFFACTORIO-FORCE_REDIRECTION.descri: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] for each stack of [gold]Weak[/gold], [gold]Vulnerable[/gold], [gold]Scorch[/gold], and [gold]Shock[/gold] on the hit enemy.
SPIREOFFACTORIO-OVERHEAT.title: Overheat
SPIREOFFACTORIO-OVERHEAT.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage and apply {ScorchEnemies} [gold]Scorch[/gold] to all enemies. Apply {ScorchSelf} [gold]Scorch[/gold] to yourself.
